title:
—For old Mary Ann
 She doesn’t care a damn.
 But, hising up her petticoats...
html_source:
This is from a bawdy Irish song. He leaves off the last line where:

She pisses like a man

anchor.prefix:
antly. Do you think she was? Quite charming!

—
anchor.suffix:
He crammed his mouth with fry and munched and droned. 

 The doorway was darkened by an entering form. 

 — The milk, sir!
